KEY FEATURES
What This System Does
◉
Real-Time Detection Dashboard
A responsive analytics dashboard displaying wildlife detection records with heatmaps, camera feeds, and statistical charts. Built with React.js and CSS Grid for optimal data visualization.
⌁
RESTful API Architecture
Designed and implemented RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express for CRUD operations on wildlife detection records. Endpoints support filtering, pagination, and aggregated analytics queries.
⛁
PostgreSQL Data Management
Structured relational database schema with indexed tables for detection events, camera locations, species catalog, and user management. Optimized queries for real-time analytics aggregation.
▣
Data Science Integration
Collaborated on integrating data science models for wildlife monitoring. The backend serves as the bridge between ML inference pipelines and the frontend visualization layer.
▯
Responsive UI Design
Mobile-first responsive interface ensuring sanctuary staff can access detection data on tablets and phones while on field patrol. CSS Flexbox and Grid with custom breakpoints.
◔
Species Analytics & Reporting
Automated reporting module generating species sighting trends, population estimates, and anomaly alerts from detection data. Exports CSV and PDF reports for conservation teams.
